New benchmarks on long-haul flights 

SWISS Premium Economy is first choice for passengers who appreciate individuality and wish to arrive at their destination feeling even more relaxed. Compared to SWISS Economy you can look forward to a latest generation seat that promises more privacy, enhanced comfort and the best entertainment at an attractive price. 

Travel in comfort

You will love the comfortable seat, above all due to its innovative hard-shell design. You can adjust it effortlessly without disturbing your fellow passengers in the row behind you.

Explore cabin features in SWISS Premium Economy

Wider food selection

Enjoy an alcohol-free welcome drink before take-off and as a passenger in SWISS Premium Economy look forward to an expanded culinary selection. 

To SWISS Premium Economy

Best entertainment

The best entertainment is guaranteed on our 15.6-inch screens. Look forward to the latest Hollywood films as well as Swiss productions and the latest TV series in stunning quality. At your seat you will also get high-quality, noise-reducing headphones, allowing you to enjoy your film or music even more. 

Explore inflight entertainment on long haul flights

Easy check in

Check in quickly and with no queues. Online check-in will take you to your boarding pass in just a few steps. You can choose automated check-in if you book your flight on swiss.com. We will send you your boarding pass by e-mail to print out or directly to your smartphone as a mobile boarding pass.

Go to online check-in

Extra baggage

Travellers in SWISS Premium Economy enjoy a double baggage allowance (2x 23kg) compared to travellers in SWISS Economy. This does not apply to the SWISS Premium Economy Light fare, which only allows you to take one piece of checked baggage (1x23kg) with you.

Explore checked baggage

Your toiletries bag

In SWISS Premium Economy you will receive a toiletries bag made from sustainable materials and containing a toothbrush and toothpaste, a sleeping mask and ear-plugs. This is available in different variants, shapes and colours depending on the departure airport. 

A breeze of crisp alpine air on board​

​Enjoy our signature scent “Alpine Valley”, developed and exclusively created in partnership with Soeder. The fragrance captures the subtle and fresh essence of the Swiss Alps and brings a feeling of home and comfort right on board your flight. 

Earn miles

Miles & More is the biggest frequent flyer programme in Europe. Earn miles on all your flights and enjoy greater comforts and more benefits when travelling as a member.
